messages:
Emma: Heads up Customer: digital bank POC. Requirements: keep traffic inside customer network if possible, single allowlist entry for POC, preserve originating client IP for logging, and support mTLS between their proxy and our endpoint. Thoughts on best path?
Diego: TL;DR: PrivateLink EndpointService + NLB on our side is the lowest-friction. It creates interface ENIs in their VPC (no public egress). To preserve client IP we can enable proxy-protocol / NLB passthrough or accept X-Forwarded-For from their proxy.
Sam: If they insist on a single public IP only, that forces NAT/EIP fronting (public egress). We can provide a small EIP pool behind an NLB for POC, but that'll reintroduce public routing and extra firewall reviews.
Priya: mTLS: we support client cert validation on the listener. For POC we need them to provide a client cert or we can mutually-issue a short-lived cert. Also confirm whether they want cert pinning in the firewall.
Emma: They want minimal firewall churn. Can we give them a one-line SG snippet and note ephemeral port guidance?
Diego: Example snippet they can paste: 
```
allow tcp 443 from 10.50.0.0/16  # spoke CIDR -> endpoint ENI
allow established,related from 10.50.0.0/16
# If using EIP POC: allow tcp 443 to 54.210.11.22/32
```
Sam: Also call out health check IPs if they probe from their firewall. For PrivateLink we publish ENI IPs after creation; for EIP we give them the addresses up front.
Priya: Cost bullets for playbook: 
- PrivateLink POC: minor hourly endpoint fee + $/GB data (cheap for low RPS)
- NAT/EIP POC: NAT GW hourly + $/GB, or our EIP pool (small monthly fee)
Note: at >1TB/month traffic, NAT with owned egress boxes can be cheaper but adds ops.
Emma: Enterprise blocker checklist: 1) cross-account ENIs require security review; 2) some banks ban interface endpoints; 3) TLS-inspect must be customer-managed and placed before endpoint. Let's pre-seed these items in the security Q.
Diego: Action items: - @Emma: confirm spoke CIDR + prefer PL vs EIP. - @Sam: prepare EIP pool quote if they insist on single IP. - @Priya: draft security Q answers (mTLS/cert flow + source-IP guidance).
netops-bot: Ticket POC-9983 created and assigned to @Sam/@Priya. Attach playbook here when ready.
Emma: Meeting Thurs 11am GMT with their netsec. I'll push for PrivateLink first and offer EIP fallback.
